text:
Alex: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to reconcile the audit-export playbook with the new structured-event schema and add concrete SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/542
Maria: Nice. Can you call out the retention wording? Legal prefers 'retention period' + example TTLs instead of hard policy statements.
Alex: Good call. Current draft uses 'we retain for 90 days by default' — changed to 'default retention period (e.g., 90 days) unless customer contract specifies otherwise' in the draft.
Jordan: Also we should add a short curl + JS snippet for export so customers can reproduce the example. I sketched a JS snippet in the PR comments.
Sam: I'll add a Go example and a tiny CLI example. Want the sample to show redaction flags: `--include-pii false`.
Maria: For the SDK snippets, prefer showing both a streaming export and an on-demand export example. Many customers ask about large-volume exports and pagination.
Alex: Agree. Jordan — can you add the streaming example? Sam will add the paginated CLI and Go SDK.
Jordan: Yup. Streaming pseudo-code I added:
```
// streaming export (node)
const stream = await client.exports.stream({tenant: 'acme', since: '2026-01-01', redact: true});
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process(chunk);
}
```
Maria: That looks good. For the retention phrasing — Legal, can you 👍 on the sentence: "Default retention periods are illustrative; enforceable retention is determined by customer contract, compliance needs, and applicable laws." ?
Legal: LGTM. Suggest small tweak: replace 'illustrative' with 'guidance' and add 'and can be overridden per-customer on Dedicated/Private deployments.' So final: "Default retention periods are guidance; enforceable retention is determined by customer contract, compliance needs, applicable laws, and can be overridden per-customer on Dedicated/Private deployments." 
Alex: Updated in PR.
docs-bot: link-checker found 1 broken link in docs/export-playbook.md: https://old.company.internal/export-guidelines -> 404
Sam: I can fix that link to the new export guide: https://docs.redwood.com/export-playbook#export-guidelines (will push commit)
Jordan: Also noticed the JSON schema example uses `user_id` in plain text — we should show pseudonymization example and a short snippet for pseudonymization logic.
Alex: Good catch. I added a small note and example function for pseudonymize:
```
function pseudonymize(record) {
  return {...record, user_id: hash(record.user_id)};
}
```
Maria: One more doc tone item — keep the examples as minimal as possible and put extended examples behind a 'More examples' subheading.
Alex: Done. PR now has:
- retention wording updated per Legal
- JS streaming snippet
- Go SDK snippet from Sam
- CLI pagination example
- pseudonymization example
- link fix (Sam will push)
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/542
Sam: pushed the link fix and Go snippet in commit 7f3a1d3.
Alex: Thanks. @Maria @Legal — can you do a final quick review? Nothing else urgent here.
Maria: I'll take a look in ~30m.
Legal: Reviewing now, small nit on punctuation — left a suggestion.
Jordan: Leaving an approve once streaming example is formatted as fenced code with language marker.
Alex: All addressed per comments, merged staging -> main after tests. Closing thread.
Sam: :shipit:
Maria: :white_check_mark:
